tasks.short: Advise clients on self-care such as diabetes

steps.what: Advise clients and community groups on issues related to diabetes management and self-care

tasks.design: She advises the client or the group in the room on self-care, including diabetes management. The advice is spoken and no version is filed. Nothing drafts a note, lists tips, or sends a message.
tasks.previous_blocker: The advice has to fit this person's day, food and medicines.
tasks.enabler_now: No tool gives that advice in her place.
tasks.still_hard: Wrong self-care advice can harm someone with diabetes.
tasks.human_edge: She hears what this person can actually do this week.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still gives the diabetes advice herself.

reach.task: Prepare a group session on the same self-care point
reach.learn: Which words she used that the person understood

evidence.claim: Advice on diabetes self-care is given by the worker in the room with the person. This is model knowledge.

assumptions: The upkeep allowance is zero because no tool is added.
Clients and community groups are outside the organisation. The advice is spoken and no version is filed, so the step stays ungated.
The conversation is not recorded. Nothing drafts a note, lists tips, or sends a message.
unknowns: Whether a clinician has already set the diabetes steps she is allowed to explain.
research_questions: How often does a diabetes conversation in a week turn on medicines rather than on daily self-care?

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added to this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Both ends are zero. She still gives every self-care and diabetes conversation herself, and no tool is added.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Advise clients on diet, exercise and general health

steps.what: Advise clients and community groups on issues related to improving general health, diet or exercise

tasks.design: She advises the client or the group in the room on diet, exercise and general health. The advice is spoken and no version is filed. Nothing drafts a meal note, lists exercises, or sends a message.
tasks.previous_blocker: Diet and exercise advice has to fit this person's kitchen, work and body.
tasks.enabler_now: No tool holds that conversation in her place.
tasks.still_hard: A diet that ignores an illness can harm the person.
tasks.human_edge: She sees what food and movement are realistic here.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still gives the diet and exercise advice herself.

reach.task: Follow up the diet point at the next clinic visit
reach.learn: What the person agreed to try this week

evidence.claim: Advice on diet, exercise and general health is given by the worker in the room with the person. This is model knowledge.

assumptions: The upkeep allowance is zero because no tool is added.
Clients and community groups are outside the organisation. The advice is spoken and no version is filed, so the step stays ungated.
The conversation is not recorded. Nothing drafts a meal note, lists exercises, or sends a message.
unknowns: Whether a clinician has already restricted the diet she may suggest.
research_questions: How often does a diet conversation in a week include a medical diet rather than general food advice?

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added to this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Both ends are zero. She still gives every diet and exercise conversation herself, and no tool is added.

tasks.short: Develop a health plan or formal contract

steps.what: Talk with individuals, families or community groups about their health
Develop plans and formal contracts to improve overall health
File formal contract v1 in the case record

tasks.design: She agrees the health aim with the person or group, writes the plan or formal contract herself, and files that version in the case record. Nothing drafts the contract, lists goals, or sends it to anyone.
tasks.previous_blocker: The plan has to be one this person will follow, not a generic text.
tasks.enabler_now: No tool writes that contract in her place.
tasks.still_hard: A plan that misses an illness or a family constraint will not be kept.
tasks.human_edge: She writes only what the person agreed in the room.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still agrees the aim and still writes and files the contract.

reach.task: Continue support after the contract is filed
reach.learn: Which health goal the person agreed

evidence.claim: A health plan or formal contract is written by the worker with the person, not generated for her. This is model knowledge.
Health data is a special category of personal data.

assumptions: The upkeep allowance is zero because no tool is added.
Individuals, families and community groups are outside the organisation. The talk in s1 is spoken and no version is filed, so it stays ungated.
She writes the contract text herself in s2. Filing formal contract v1 in s3 is the standing version, and she gates that file herself.
The conversation is not recorded. Nothing drafts the contract or sends it.
unknowns: Whether this organisation's case record already has a required contract template.
research_questions: How often is the filed contract also handed to the person as a copy they keep?

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added to this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Both ends are zero. She still holds the conversation, still writes the contract, and still files it, and no tool is added.

tasks.short: Advocate health needs with agencies or providers

steps.what: Read the individual or community health needs
Advocate those needs with government agencies or health service providers

tasks.design: She reads the person's or the community's health needs and advocates them in person with the government agency or the health service provider. Nothing lists agencies, drafts a letter, or sends one.
tasks.previous_blocker: The agency has to hear this person's situation, not a generic request.
tasks.enabler_now: No tool makes that case to the agency.
tasks.still_hard: A missed need can leave the person without a service.
tasks.human_edge: She knows which detail the agency still has wrong.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still reads the needs and still speaks to the agency or the provider.

reach.task: Pick up the practical request after the advocacy meeting

evidence.claim: Advocacy with a government agency or a health service provider is done by the worker in person. This is model knowledge.

assumptions: The upkeep allowance is zero because no tool is added.
Government agencies and health service providers are outside the organisation. The advocacy is spoken and no version is filed, so the step stays ungated.
She still opens and reads the case notes. Nothing lists agencies, drafts a letter, or sends one.
unknowns: Whether some advocacy in this organisation is a written letter rather than a meeting.
research_questions: How many advocacy contacts in a week are meetings, and how many are letters that leave a filed copy?

incremental.description: No upkeep, because no tool is added to this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Both ends are zero. She still reads every case and still advocates in person, and no tool is added.
